chunks.heading: **Re: Revised Panel of Actuaries**
chunks.content:
The Authority had formed Panel of Actuaries for a period of 3 years from 1-4-2017 to 31-03- 2020 vide circular ref: IRDA/ACTL/MISC/MISC/074/03/2017 dated 31-03- 2017. 

Ms. Tania Chakrabarti has joined a General Insurance Company, as a fulltime employee. 

In view of the above, she is no longer a Panel Actuary from the aforementioned Panel. Accordingly, the revised panel with name and contact details of the actuaries is given below.
